descr.name: A screen to identify synthetic lethal interactions with E-cadherin in an MCF10A isogenic cell line
description: Genome wide protein coding siRNA screen to identify synthetic lethal interactions with E-cadherin in an MCF10A isogenic cell line
protocol: The transfection is performed in duplicate in 384 well plates for each cell line (A and B for MCF10A, C and D for CDH1-/-)

The human siRNA library (Dharmacon GE) consists of 18,120 individual protein coding genes consisting of the following gene families: Protein kinases (G-003505), GPCR (G-003605), Phosphatases (G-003705), Ion channel (G-003805), Drug targets (G-004655), Remaining genome (G-005005), Protease (G-005105), Ubiquitin conjugation 1 (G-005615), Ubiquitin conjugation 2 (G-005625), Ubiquitin conjugation 3 (G-005635)
siRNA - 21 bp chemically synthesized sequences, arrayed format (384 well plates, diluted in 1x siRNA buffer (Dharmacon GE source).
Unique siRNA molecules per reagent pool:

SMARTpool siRNAs (Dharmacon RNAi Technologies). 4 individual siRNAs targeting each gene, pooled together in one well. Ideally, the 4 sequences will target all isoforms/transcript variants of a gene and they are generally in the coding region.
700 MCF10A cells per well or 900 CDH1-/- cells per well were plated in a 384 well plate
Dharmacon RNAi Technologies for siRNA. Promega for Cell Titer Glo.
Celltiter-Glo luminescent assay- end point assay for viability that measures ATP in the cell.

All siRNA and lipid/opti-MEM complexing is performed in 1 plate (A plate) and subsequently transferred to assay plates B, C and D.  6ul siRNA (1uM stock) is added to 44ul lipid:opti-MEM mix, mixed and complexed for 20 minutes in plate A. Then 12.5ul is transferred to plates B, C and D.  Final concentration of SMARTpool is 40 nM. All liquid handling steps performing using a Calliper Sciclone ALH3000 liquid handling robot. Cells were reverse transfected by adding 25ul of cells per well to the pre-mixed siRNA/lipid complex using a Biotek 406 (Biotek) dispense workstation.
700 MCF10A cells per well or 900 CDH1-/- cells per well were plated in a 384 well plate
siRNA is added to pre-diluted lipid in opti-MEM, mixed and complexed for 20 minutes.
White walled, clear bottom 384-well plate. Tissue-culture treated polystyrene, flat bottom, with lid.
DMEM-F12 with glutamate, 5% horse serum, 20ng/mL EGF, 0.5ug/mL hydrocortisone, 100ng/mL cholera toxin, 10ug/mL insulin

results.name: SYNTHETIC_LETHALITY_BIN
description: synthetic lethality binning criteria i. SL1 bin if MCF10A_AVERAGE_CTG_NORMALISED_TO_AVERAGE_MOCK_ACROSS_PLATES value 0.85-1.1 and a VIABILITY_RATIO_FROM_NORMALISED_MCF10A_AND_CDH_VIABILITY value less than or equal to 0.85 ii. SL2 bin if MCF10A_AVERAGE_CTG_NORMALISED_TO_AVERAGE_MOCK_ACROSS_PLATES value of 0.70-0.84 and a VIABILITY_RATIO_FROM_NORMALISED_MCF10A_AND_CDH_VIABILITY value less than or equal to 0.85 iii. SL3 bin if MCF10A_AVERAGE_CTG_NORMALISED_TO_AVERAGE_MOCK_ACROSS_PLATES value of 0.50-0.69 and a VIABILITY_RATIO_FROM_NORMALISED_MCF10A_AND_CDH_VIABILITY value less than or equal to 0.75 iv. RSL bin if CDH1_AVERAGE_CTG_NORMALISED_TO_AVERAGE_MOCK_ACROSS_PLATES value of greater than or equal to 0.70 and a VIABILITY_RATIO_FROM_NORMALISED_MCF10A_AND_CDH_VIABILITY value greater than or equal to 1.15 v.  TOX bin if MCF10A_AVERAGE_CTG_NORMALISED_TO_AVERAGE_MOCK_ACROSS_PLATES value of less than 0.5 and a CDH1_AVERAGE_CTG_NORMALISED_TO_AVERAGE_MOCK_ACROSS_PLATES value of less than 0.5 iv. else NC bin
